projects.title: Accessible Product Landing Page
projects.description: Build a fully accessible landing page for a product, applying semantic HTML, alt text, form labels, keyboard navigation, and contrast.

projects.title: Accessible Recipe App
projects.description: Create an interactive recipe app with a combobox, tabs, collapsible sections, live regions, and a multi-step form, all keyboard and screen reader friendly.

projects.title: Accessible Media Gallery
projects.description: Develop a responsive media gallery featuring video with captions, audio with transcript, custom controls, a modal, and full mobile/touch accessibility.
